objective: Minimize total compressed motive air / total powder, minimize first-wall contact and coagulation, maximize recovered high-shear coverage. No hard coagulation cutoff.
scope: Parallel separate outlets. Equal powder per unit; distinct geometry and motive pressures allowed. Every nozzle counted. No additional compressed carrier gas. Feed/header/merge losses not simulated. Series and opposed-jet layouts are unranked.
paretoDefinition: Four objectives evaluated using the worse mean across two closures. Screening uncertainty is not a formal dominance test.
